title: IKEA Run
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §5 (2.4) + 4.2 ('crafting bench = kitchen table, the one that didn't fit'), game_components §5–7 (furniture = capacity + crafting stations, IKEA a money sink), art_pipeline ('big-box blue+yellow warehouse, logo-free'), the 1.3 flat-pack joke at Shanthamma's gate, ADR-115 (metro fares) and ADR-127 (metro_tier_1 opens Majestic). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P13 builds it.
time: A Saturday — the first sleep after act2_guitar_done (Sameer's chat sets it up)
player_goal: Buy flat-pack furniture at Nagasandra and get it home on the metro.
design_goal: Progress: the Green Line opens to you (metro_tier_1 from 2.2 → Majestic interchange → Nagasandra) — the map grows past one line. Challenge: a carry limit (box slots) turns shopping into choosing, and the boxes make the metro ride a comedy. Reward: the flat gains furniture by flag (ADR-122). Seed for Act 4: the kitchen table does not fit — it waits folded against the wall and becomes the crafting bench in 4.2.

cast.role: Phone only: sets up the trip ('Hyggeland opened at Nagasandra. Saturday? I need a shoe rack and a reason to leave the house.'), then cancels at the last minute ('Mom's here. Bring me a shoe rack?') — so you go alone and carry alone.
Majestic interchange: a farmer-ish uncle with a jute sack, lost between the Purple and Green platforms. Walk him to the Green Line stairs (+1 rep, majestic_helped) or point and go.
Hyggeland staffer in a yellow polo: explains the arrows on the floor, the aisle-and-bin numbers, and that home delivery to Ambedkar Nagar is ₹1,499 and 'next Thursday, maybe'. You carry it yourself.
Till: rings up the boxes, offers a blue bag (₹20). Says the carry limit out loud: 'Three boxes on the metro, saar. Four if you are brave.'
Green Line coach: an aunty whose feet your boxes keep landing on. The comedy beat — apologise, hold the box up, or give up your spot by the door.

beats.what: The first sleep after the guitar: Sameer's chat — Hyggeland (the parody blue-and-yellow store) opened at Nagasandra. Maps shows the Green Line as ridable (metro_tier_1) with Nagasandra marked. Sameer cancels on the morning of, so it's you alone.

METRO from Cubbon Park / MG Road / Whitefield → the Majestic interchange (new compressed pocket, underground): crowd, two sets of stairs with Purple and Green signs, the lost uncle with the jute sack. Down the Green stairs → a Green Line coach card → Nagasandra.

Hyggeland (new interior pocket): arrows on the floor through three room sets — kitchen, living room, bedroom — each with a price tag you can inspect; the café (₹49 cinnamon bun, ₹79 'masala meatballs'); the self-serve aisle where you pick up boxes by number.

The carry limit: 3 box slots (the HUD shows ▢▢▢). Kitchen table + two chairs ₹4,999 (2 slots) · bookshelf ₹2,499 (2 slots) · floor lamp ₹999 (1) · rug ₹1,499 (1) · shoe rack for Sameer ₹699 (1). Pick at the aisle, pay at the till; a fourth slot is possible but the metro beat gets harder. Delivery (₹1,499, 'next Thursday') is offered and refused by default — the scene is about carrying.

The ride home: Green Line coach (the metro_interior pattern, green stripe) → change at Majestic (a card) → Purple Line to Whitefield. The boxes take the door space; the aunty beat (three choices, ±rep); with 4 boxes one slides on a brake and the coach laughs. Off at Whitefield, the hill bus — the conductor sighs and makes you buy a luggage ticket (₹10 per box).

Assembly at the flat: step to the boxes → a three-step dialogue 'manual' (step 2 has a wrong option; one screw is always left over). Shelf, lamp, rug appear as objects by flag. The kitchen table does not fit — there's a cot, a table-chair and a stove already — so it stays folded against the wall ('One day you'll have a kitchen. Or a reason.').
Sameer's chat: 'Did you get my shoe rack?' — yes (he pays you back ₹699 by UPI) or no ('Typical.'). Act 4 reads table_folded (the crafting bench) and the shelf (base storage).

economy.trigger: metro to Majestic + Green Line to Nagasandra (ADR-115 fare, one fare for the trip)
shoe rack (for Sameer; ₹699 back by UPI)
luggage ticket on the hill bus, per box

hyggeland pocket: one big-box interior render + spec — arrows on the floor, three room sets, a café counter, a self-serve aisle of numbered racks (numbers drawn as shapes, no text), tills; logo-free blue-and-yellow; no ceiling fans
green_coach: the metro_interior render with a green stripe (a recolour of the Purple Line coach, or a new render)
props sheet: flat-pack boxes (big / small), a folded kitchen table against a wall, a bookshelf, a floor lamp, a rug, a shoe rack
sheets: the Majestic uncle (jute sack), Hyggeland staffer and cashier (yellow polos), the aunty on the coach
HUD: a box-slot meter (▢▢▢) while carrying (kit atoms)
acceptance: the first sleep after act2_guitar_done sets ikea_planned; Sameer's chat lands; Maps offers METRO to Majestic (metro_tier_1) before the first visit

open_questions: The STORE's name: draft 'Hyggeland' (a parody, no real brand, blue-and-yellow, logo-free). Your pick?
MAJESTIC: draft = a small interchange pocket with the lost uncle (one more render). Cheaper alternative = a transit card 'Change at Majestic' with no pocket.
The CARRY LIMIT: draft 3 box slots (a 4th allowed, the ride gets harder). Or a hard 3? Or no limit and the comedy only?
The FURNITURE and prices: kitchen table + chairs ₹4,999 (2) · bookshelf ₹2,499 (2) · floor lamp ₹999 (1) · rug ₹1,499 (1) · shoe rack ₹699 (1). Add a fridge (game_components says 'fridge later')?
The TABLE that doesn't fit: draft = it always stays folded against the wall (the Act 4 crafting bench, story 4.2). Or let the player swap out the old table-chair to make room?
SAMEER: draft = he cancels, you go alone, the shoe rack is a favour. Or he comes along and carries (+2 slots, more chat on the ride)?
ASSEMBLY: draft = a three-step dialogue 'manual' with one wrong step and the leftover screw. Or reuse the rhythm lane as an Allen-key mini-game?
WHEN: draft = the first sleep after the guitar. Or the next payday (the second salary)?

The RIDE HOME: Green → Majestic (card) → Purple → Whitefield → hill bus with a ₹10/box luggage ticket. Keep the luggage ticket? And the scooter cannot carry flat-pack (one line from Noor if you try) — keep?
